name: get_nic_framework_materiality
description: What SASB, Sustainalytics and MSCI each prescribe as material for a NIC-2008 industry, from the scraped framework corpora and their curated NIC crosswalks. Give it `nic_codes` (2-8 digit, resolved to their NIC Division) or an NSE `symbol` (its BRSR Section A product rows are turnover-weighted onto Divisions; `scope.from_symbol.turnoverShares` shows the split). Per framework it returns `matched_industries` (with `matched_at`: "division" for an exact NIC Division hit, "section" when nothing mapped and the match widened to the whole NIC Section — a sector-level answer — plus the crosswalk author's `crosswalk_confidence`) and the union of `issues` those industries flag, each with `prevalence` (share of matched industries flagging it), the framework's own `framework_grouping`, and for MSCI `avg_weight_pct` / `max_weight_pct` / `company_specific`. SASB issues carry their industry-specific `disclosure_topics` when the match is division-level. Batched: call ONCE with everything. 1-10 NIC codes, clamped server-side — strict tool-use schemas reject array/numeric bounds.

nic_codes.description: NIC-2008 codes, 2-8 digits, e.g. ["20119", "19201"]; 1-10, clamped server-side. Omit when passing a symbol.

symbol.description: NSE ticker, e.g. "RELIANCE" — its BRSR filing's NIC codes are used. Ignored when nic_codes is given.

frameworks.description: Subset to query; omit or null for all three. Drop "msci" for a table free of proprietary reference data.

name: emit_framework_materiality_table
description: Return the complete deduplicated framework-materiality table (topics with description, pillar, per-framework mappings and MSCI weight + the resolved NIC scope + per-framework coverage + methodology + caveats). Call exactly once when finished.
